draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.64, the 233rd-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 17th of 19 at RB. He went 194th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (233rd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (98th percentile), broad jump (88th percentile). College production: 878 rushing yards in 2020, 8th of 19 RBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2025. 28 career games and 12 starts over 4 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 7 in 2021. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (4th percentile). Played 1 of 17 games in 2025.
